metadata.title: Retro Rock Portrait with High-Contrast Grain

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-grain, cinematic portrait of a female rock artist crouched on a dark asphalt surface. The lighting is directional and warm, creating a strong contrast between the deep blue-toned shadows of the ground and the golden highlights on the subject's skin and voluminous, textured hair.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm skin tones against cool-toned blue asphalt
Rough texture of the ground mirroring the grain of the film
Dynamic crouched posture centered against a vast, dark negative space
Sharp horizontal rule separating the primary title from the subtitle
coreInvariants: Heavy film grain texture across the entire image
Subject wearing a black leather vest and ripped denim

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered horizontally, occupying the middle and lower two-thirds of the frame in a crouched position.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and hair, illuminated by a warm light source from the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large display text in the top left, move down the subject's hair to the crouched form, and follow the diagonal of the asphalt.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant dark, textured negative space in the upper right and lower left corners.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep indigo and charcoal (asphalt and shadows)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm amber and peach (skin highlights and hair)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between highlights and shadows; saturation is concentrated in the warm tones while shadows remain desaturated and cool.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones, blues, and blacks

letterConstructionRules: Display text uses ultra-thin, elongated strokes with wide tracking
Subtitle uses a fluid, connected cursive script with a slight slant
A thin horizontal line (rule) separates the two tiers of text
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' in the display text has a low crossbar

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed in the dark negative space above the subject
Separated by a thin white line

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High contrast between a rigid, modern geometric sans and a soft, traditional script.

preserve: Wide tracking of the top line
avoid: Serif fonts for the display line

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Futura Light or ITC Avant Garde Extra Light
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, thin-stroke uppercase aesthetic.
Captures the 80s-era script feel for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy film photograph of a woman with big, messy 80s hair, wearing a black leather vest and ripped jeans, crouching on dark blue asphalt at dusk. Use warm side-lighting to create high contrast and deep shadows. The upper left area should be dark and relatively empty.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase display text in a thin white geometric sans-serif with wide tracking in the top left. Place a thin white horizontal line below it. Under the line, add a smaller subtitle in a pink cursive script.

verificationChecks: Is the grain texture prominent across the whole frame?
Is the color palette strictly warm highlights and cool shadows?
Is the display text thin and widely spaced?
Is there a clear horizontal line separating the two text elements?

adjustableVariables: Tracking width of the display text
mustRedesign: Any modern digital clarity; must look like 1980s film
Standard tracking; must be wide for the top line
Flat lighting; must be high-contrast directional light
postGenerationChecks: Check for visible grain in the shadows
Ensure the text does not overlap the subject's face
Verify the horizontal rule is perfectly straight
Confirm the script text is legible but smaller than the display text
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a high-grain textured asphalt background, place a central subject in 80s rock attire with warm directional lighting, and apply a two-tier typographic header in the top-left corner using a thin geometric sans and a pink script separated by a rule.
